name: Confused_2
short_caption: The robot brings both hands forward, turning its palms up in a questioning, hesitant gesture.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral standing posture and slowly brings both hands inward and upward toward the center of its torso. It rotates its forearms so that the palms face upward with fingers slightly spread, holding this open-handed posture for a moment. Finally, it smoothly lowers both arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral resting position.
safety_notes: None. The arms remain close to the body within its standard cylindrical footprint.
